conclusion: The reported MCP 2026-07-28 findings were reproduced where applicable and corrected. Strict schema publication, monotonic progress, resource error mapping, terminal-state precedence, stateless HTTP behavior, admin protocol errors, static-token semantics, streaming concurrency, ResourceLink output, and raw HTTP wire behavior are covered by regression tests.

resolved.summary: Invalid workflow JSON Schema is rejected and the workflow is isolated
Progress notifications use a request-wide strictly increasing sequence
Missing and unsupported resources return JSON-RPC -32602
Failure terminal states cannot be overwritten by completed
HTTP runs stateless and rejects requests missing the 2026 protocol header without creating sessions
Unknown admin tools raise protocol Invalid Params
Static bearer-token mode no longer advertises OAuth Protected Resource Metadata
Pure ASGI concurrency control holds its slot through the final streaming body frame
Completed job outputs include native MCP ResourceLink blocks
Raw HTTP tests cover 2026 headers, resultType, statelessness, methods, and resource errors
